verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit generates AI-driven insights (PR summaries, walkthroughs, diagrams, prioritized triage), suggestions (code fixes, unit tests, refactors), and conversational analysis (chat, investigate) directly from the user's codebase and PR data, with both first-party docs and positive hands-on community reports corroborating quality. Missing for 10: independent quantitative benchmarking of suggestion accuracy beyond anecdotal community comments.
